title: Which line of the rectangle should we draw first?
description: A rectangle has one known side of five centimetres and one known diagonal of seven centimetres, and the video decides which line goes first. Keeko's doubt is that the longest line should be drawn first, and the video breaks it.
teaching_notes: One idea: draw first the line whose length and direction are both certain, which is the known side, and place everything else from it. Watch for students who start with the longest line.

source: To construct the rectangle with a side of 5 cm and a diagona
video_script.why: A learner picks the first line of a construction by asking which line can be drawn exactly from what is given.
video_script.substitution: the book's rectangle ABCD with the side DC of five centimetres and the diagonal DB of seven centimetres
video_script.anchor: the book's rectangle ABCD with the side DC marked 5 cm and the diagonal DB marked 7 cm
video_script.wrong_answer: draw the diagonal first, because it is the longest line
video_script.wrong_move: starts with the longest line, though a slanting line can point in any direction and does not place the other corners
video_script.payoff_line: Draw the base dee cee of five centimetres first.

final_answer.value: the base CD, which is 5 cm long
final_answer.spoken: the base of five centimetres goes first

maths_rules: only one length that is a side is known: 5 cm
a side can be drawn first as the base, with its direction chosen freely
a slanting line of 7 cm can point in any direction, so it cannot place the other corners
the other points are found from the base by perpendiculars and a compass arc
video_script.design: The two known lengths are shown on a rough rectangle. A slanting line of seven centimetres is tried at several tilts, and then the base is drawn.
